items.maltese: Hi kienet tqatta' ħin mal-familja tagħha kuljum.
items.english: She used to spend time with her family every day.
items.note: Hi is the woman spending time; tagħha refers to her family. Kienet with tqatta' and kuljum describes a past habit here, not one ongoing event.

items.maltese: Min jitwieled tond ma jmutx kwadru.
items.english: Whoever is born round does not die square.
items.note: Proverb: ingrained habits or character do not easily change. Min means whoever, a general person, not a particular woman or neighbour. The round/square contrast is figurative, not a literal or inevitable rule about people.

groups.title: Rita's routine
groups.provenance: MQF 2 · Lesson 05, Lesson 05 - Material Analysis.md · imperfett 1, exercise 4

items.maltese: Rita tqum kmieni ħafna għax qabel tmur għax-xogħol tagħmel ħafna xogħol tad-dar.
items.english: Rita gets up very early because she does a lot of housework before going to work.

items.maltese: Malli tidħol fil-kċina, tipprepara l-kolazzjon għaliha u għall-familja.
items.english: As soon as she goes into the kitchen, she prepares breakfast for herself and her family.

items.maltese: Wara li tiekol il-kolazzjon, tilbes il-ħwejjeġ tax-xogħol u toħroġ il-karozza mill-garaxx.
items.english: After breakfast she puts on her work clothes and takes the car out of the garage.

items.maltese: Fit-triq, jekk issib ħafna traffiku, tasal tard.
items.english: On the way, if she hits heavy traffic, she arrives late.

items.maltese: Kif tispiċċa mix-xogħol, tmur tixtri biex malli tasal id-dar tibda ssajjar.
items.english: When she finishes work, she goes shopping so she can start cooking as soon as she gets home.

items.maltese: Wara l-ikel, Rita taħsel il-platti u wara tara ftit televiżjoni.
items.english: After the meal, Rita washes the dishes and then watches a little television.

items.maltese: F'xil-għaxra titla' fuq u tmur torqod.
items.english: At around ten, she goes upstairs and goes to bed.

groups.title: Marija and Karla at the supermarket
groups.provenance: MQF 2 · Lesson 05, Lesson 05 - Material Analysis.md · imperfett djalogu, exercise 3

items.maltese: Marija: Sejra sas-supermarkit, trid tiġi miegħi?
items.english: Marija: I'm going to the supermarket. Do you want to come with me?

items.maltese: Karla: Iva, mela le. Ħa mmur nitfi l-ikel.
items.english: Karla: Yes, of course. I'll go turn off the heat.
Marija: Yes, wait.
Karla: I'm ready. Let's go.

items.maltese: Marija: Għandi bżonn nixtri ftit frott, naqra ġobon u biċċa laħam.
items.english: Marija: I need to buy some fruit, a little cheese and a piece of meat.

items.maltese: Karla: Jien se nara xi ħwejjeġ għat-tfal.
items.english: Karla: I'm going to look at some clothes for the children.
Marija: All right.

items.maltese: Karla: Jien lesta u sejra nħallas.
items.english: Karla: I'm done and I'm going to pay.
Marija: Me too.

items.maltese: Marija: Grazzi talli ġejt miegħi. Nieħu gost nitkellem miegħek.
items.english: Marija: Thank you for coming with me. I enjoy talking to you.
Karla: I feel the same way.
